title: Answered Bank Deposit Information Requests and Personal Sender Account Limits Callbacks
content:
For a callback on limits and levels to a Personal Sender Account holder, transfer information already answered is the number of answers to transfer-level requests for information logged on the customer's Bank Deposit transfers in the 6 months before the callback request date, an answer dated on the same calendar day 6 months earlier or before it no longer counting.

- When it is 2 or more, 2 business days are added to the counted limits callback window.
- When it is exactly 1, 1 business day is added to the counted limits callback window.
- When there is none, nothing is added for transfer information already answered.

## Where the answers are found

Each answer is an information request answer logged in the case file of one of the customer's Bank Deposit transfers, counted by its case date. Answers logged on Cash Pickup or Mobile Wallet transfers are not part of this count.

## Points of judgement

| Answers logged on Bank Deposit transfers in the 6 months | Business days added |
|---|---|
| 0 | 0 |
| 1 | 1 |
| 2 | 2 |
| 5 | 2 |

Hypothetical dates: for a callback requested on 30 September, an answer logged on 31 March of the same year still counts, and one logged on 30 March or before it no longer counts.
